description: The deposit documents literature selection, analysis models and figures for a study of European district-heating transition policies. It records the relationship between systems analysis and governance evidence. The provider is Cem Gürsan, Radboud University. Coverage: The title identifies Europe. The deposit is version 2 from August 2024; the reviewed-literature period and country coverage are not fully specified in its short description. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states CC-BY-4.0 for the shared material. Underlying secondary-source coding is explicitly withheld for legal ownership reasons. Limitations: The provider does not expose the full coding analysis. The public description does not establish an executable systems-dynamics model or reproducible source dataset. For simulation it may inform qualitative feedback structures and policy assumptions, subject to checking the actual model files. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
